SIFEN Certificate Expiry Warning

Dear Administrator,

This is an automated notification that the SIFEN digital certificate for {{ object.name }} is about to expire.

Company: {{ object.name }}
Certificate Expiry: {{ object.l10n_py_certificate_expiry }}

Action Required:

  1. Contact your certificate provider to renew the certificate
  2. Upload the new certificate in Settings > Companies > EDI Configuration
  3. Test the connection before the current certificate expires

If the certificate expires, EDI documents cannot be sent to SIFEN.

Best regards,
Odoo System
